name: The Mistvale Road
description: A dirt road that climbs from the castle toward the mountains, and the fog.

castle_road.name: Castle Road
castle_road.description: The road bends away from the castle gate between low hedges.

river_bridge.name: River Bridge
river_bridge.description: A hump-backed bridge over a cold, fast river.

signal_hill.name: Signal Hill
signal_hill.description: A bare hill topped by a cold beacon. The mountains fill the north.

fogreach_mouth.name: Mouth of Fogreach Cave
fogreach_mouth.description: A black cave mouth in the hillside, breathing cold air. Fog curls out along the ground.
